candidates.formal_type: (k : Type u_1) → [Field.{u_1} k] → Nat → Type u_1

∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] (n : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 n → Eq.{1} (Module.finrank.{u_1, u_1} k (Etingof.TruncPolySimple.{u_1} k n)) 1

∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] (n : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 n →
    IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_1} (AdjoinRoot.{u_1} (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} Polynomial.X.{u_1} n))
      (Etingof.TruncPolySimple.{u_1} k n)

∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] (n : Nat),
  LT.lt.{0} 0 n →
    ∀ (M : Type u_2) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} M]
      [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} (AdjoinRoot.{u_1} (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} Polynomial.X.{u_1} n)) M]
      [IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_2} (AdjoinRoot.{u_1} (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} Polynomial.X.{u_1} n)) M],
      Nonempty.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)}
        (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_1}
          (RingHom.id.{u_1} (AdjoinRoot.{u_1} (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} Polynomial.X.{u_1} n))) M
          (Etingof.TruncPolySimple.{u_1} k n))

∀ (k : Type u_1) [inst : Field.{u_1} k] (n : Nat) (m : Etingof.TruncPolySimple.{u_1} k n),
  Eq.{u_1 + 1} (HSMul.hSMul.{u_1, u_1, u_1} (AdjoinRoot.root.{u_1} (HPow.hPow.{u_1, 0, u_1} Polynomial.X.{u_1} n)) m) 0
